title: West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowance) Rules, 1998
description: This is a notification by the Finance Department, Government of West Bengal, introducing the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowance) Rules, 1998[cite: 1]. These rules are deemed to have come into force on the first day of January, 1996[cite: 1]. The document provides detailed guidelines on the application of the new pay scales, fixation of initial pay, conditions for the payment of arrears, and the classification of government employees into Groups A, B, C, and D[cite: 1]. It also includes schedules detailing the correspondence between existing and revised pay scales, along with the required option forms for employees[cite: 1].
